description_en: Updates the file information about a function
description_zh: 调用UpdateUdfFile更新函数的文件信息
name: UpdateUdfFile

parameters.help_en: The path to the folder containing the function file
parameters.help_zh: 函数文件所在文件夹的路径
parameters.name: file_folder_path

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. To find this, click the wrench icon in the upper-right corner and navigate to the workspace management page
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID，
您可以单击页面右上角的小扳手图标，进入工作空间管理页面查看
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The function category, corresponding to the function type field in the Create Function form. Valid values: MATH (mathematical functions), AGGREGATE (aggregate functions), STRING (string processing functions), DATE (date processing functions), ANALYTIC (window functions), and OTHER (other functions)
parameters.help_zh:
函数的分类，
对应创建函数表单中的函数类型，包括MATH（数学运算函数）、AGGREGATE（聚合函数）、STRING（字符串处理函数）、DATE（日期处理函数）、ANALYTIC（窗口函数）和OTHER（其他函数）
parameters.name: function_type

parameters.help_en: The class name where the function is defined, corresponding to the class name field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh:
函数定义所在的类名，
对应创建函数表单的类名
parameters.name: class_name

parameters.help_en: A comma-separated list of resource names referenced by the function, corresponding to the resource list field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh:
函数引用的资源名列表，
使用英文逗号（,）分隔，对应创建函数表单中的资源列表
parameters.name: resources

parameters.example: Concatenate several strings to generate a new string
parameters.help_en: The function purpose description, corresponding to the description field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh:
函数用途的说明，
对应创建函数表单中的描述
parameters.name: udf_description

parameters.help_en: The command format for invoking the function, corresponding to the command format field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh:
函数的调用命令格式，
对应创建函数表单中的命令格式
parameters.name: cmd_description

parameters.example: List of strings to be connected
parameters.help_en:
The function parameter description, corresponding to the parameter description field in the Create Function form.

Valid values:

ALL_ALLOWD

FAILURE_ALLOWED

ALL_DENIED
parameters.help_zh:
函数入参的说明，
对应创建函数表单中的参数说明
parameters.name: parameter_description

parameters.example: New strings generated by concatenating all strings before and after the input order
parameters.help_en: The return value description, corresponding to the return value field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh:
函数的返回值说明，
对应创建函数表单中的返回值
parameters.name: return_value

parameters.help_en: An example demonstrating how to call the function, corresponding to the example field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh:
函数的调用示例，
对应创建函数表单中的示例
parameters.name: example

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the DataWorks workspace, which is the identifier at the top of the Data Studio page where you switch workspaces.

Either this parameter or ProjectId must be specified to identify the target DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的唯一标识符，
即数据开发页面顶部切换工作空间处的英文标识。

该参数与ProjectId参数二者必须设置其一，以确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID for this request. Use this ID for troubleshooting if an error occurs
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的唯一ID。出现错误后，您可以根据该ID排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request succeeded. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功：

true（成功）
false（失败）
